name: HAT-P-13
description: Star of 5,653 K, 247 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: HAT-P-13 b crosses HAT-P-13 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.

quotes.title: HAT-P-13
quotes.card: HAT-P-13, also known as GSC 03416-00543, is a G-type subgiant approximately 800 light-years away in the constellation Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: In 2009 it was discovered that this star is orbited by two massive planets, the innermost of which transits the star.

notes: HAT-P-13 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
